 vivo V80 pre-orders can score you a VVIP ticket to see ENHYPEN live in Manila
 Want to see ENHYPEN live? 📱✨ Pre-ordering the new vivo V80 gets you PHP 2,500 in perks, free earbuds, and a chance at a VVIP ticket for their Manila event! Here's everything you need to know 👇 #vivoV80 #ENHYPEN #ASTIG
 by 
 ASTIG PR 
 2 hours ago 2 hours ago 
 Advertisements 
 MANILA, Philippines (Nov 2026) – Pinoy K-pop fans looking to upgrade can score a front-row seat to see ENHYPEN live by securing the new vivo V80 smartphone. Pre-orders are officially open in the Philippines, featuring discount vouchers, free wireless earbuds, and exclusive concert access.
 Pre-order perks and freebies
 The official pre-order window runs from Oct. 26 until Nov. 13, 2026. Buyers who reserve their unit during this period get PHP 2,000 (approx. $35) off, plus a PHP 500 (approx. $9) Home Credit voucher for a total of PHP 2,500 (approx. $43) in savings. Each pre-order also includes free vivo Buds Air 3 and extra bundle items.
 Exclusive VVIP tickets for ENGENEs
 For fans hoping to watch the group live, vivo Philippines is offering a special ENHYPEN VVIP promotion. The first 100 customers to pre-order on shop.vivo.com between Oct. 26 and Nov. 8, 2026, will receive one VVIP ticket to “vivo V80 Lights Up Christmas with ENHYPEN” on Nov. 12 at the SM Mall of Asia.
 To secure the ticket, buyers must pay a PHP 1,000 (approx. $17) non-refundable down payment when ordering and settle the balance in full by Nov. 9 at 11:59 p.m.
 Pre-orders are available online via shop.vivo.com and through authorized retail stores nationwide.
